description_en: Deletes a single dynamic parameter for a specified service
description_zh: 用于删除指定服务下的单个动态参数
kebab_example: aliyun eas delete-config --cluster-id cn-hangzhou --config-type service --name my-llm-service --config-key rate_limit --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteConfig

parameters.help_en:
region ID
The region ID. Although this parameter is named `ClusterId`, it requires the region ID.
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
configuration type
The only supported value is `service`.
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en:
service name
The name of the service that contains the configuration.
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
configuration key
The key of the dynamic parameter to delete.
parameters.name: config_key
